detailed_description: JavaScript Beautifier formats or minifies pasted JavaScript with simple browser-side string processing. Choose 2 or 4 spaces, click Beautify to add line breaks around brackets, semicolons, commas, and object colons while preserving quoted strings, or click Minify to remove comments and unnecessary whitespace while keeping basic spaces between adjacent word characters. The output appears in a read-only textarea and can be copied. The tool does not parse JavaScript into an AST, validate syntax, understand every ES/JSX edge case, preserve all formatting semantics, obfuscate variable names, download .js files, or replace a project formatter such as Prettier.
usage_steps: Paste JavaScript into the input textarea
Choose 2 spaces or 4 spaces for beautified indentation
Click Beautify to apply simple line breaks and indentation
Click Minify if you want a compact output instead
Click Copy to copy the current output
usage_examples: Expand a short one-line snippet so it is easier to read
Compact a small script by removing comments and extra whitespace
Switch between 2-space and 4-space indentation for documentation examples
Clean up copied code before pasting it into your own editor for proper validation
